boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 秀巒村控溪吊橋與軍艦岩吊橋俯瞰白石溪（薩克亞金溪）與泰崗溪匯流處的軍艦岩巨岩河景（OSM hamlet 節點＋多篇行記；海拔查無權威源誠實留空）；與既有 tw-091 司馬庫斯部落觀景點（4.62km）題材錯位——本點為溪谷吊橋河景主體，司馬庫斯為部落觀景。
boosters_i18n.en: Outlook over the Baisha (Sakyajin) creek gorge and the warship-rock monolith from the Kongxi and warship-rock footbridges at Xiuluan village (OSM hamlet node; elevation honestly left empty); disjoint from tw-091 Smangus tribal viewpoint 4.62 km away (river-landform subject vs tribal viewpoint).
